mission.title: The Black Box
mission.description: Recover one of the Agents' Black Boxes intact.

npc.say: Good day. Is there anything I can help you with?
I'm afraid that I cannot let you leave, {player}.

phase.briefing: The pieces to the puzzle of the Agents are starting to fall into place and right now there is one piece that we desire. The Agents are carrying around strange Black Boxes and we need to uncover their purpose. We have theories on what they might be used for but we cannot be certain. All previous efforts in recovering one of these devices has resulted in the object being broken or damaged to the point where research was futile. We have just received word that the Agents are on site at this address. Go there now, eliminate all opposition and recover one of the Black Boxes.

enter.say: This is where we've traced the Agents. I don't know what business they are conducting here but it's my hope that you can find one of the Black Boxes on site or on one of the Agents. Good luck, {player}!

done.say: What are you doing in my desk?!

talk.say: These Agents are behind the sabotaged hardlines! It's all starting to make sense now.

objective.text: Get the Black Box from Agent Johns

done.say: That's one of the Black Boxes that we were looking for.
Excellent work, {player}. Flood will be pleased.
All programs are dead. You can ignore the bluepills.

mission.finish: Contact me when you are ready for your next assignment, {player}.
